description: Cadastral unit boundaries and data for downloading. Annual snapshot of 2024-01-01; files are updated annually. Old data structure, before the change of 08.04.2024.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Row identifier of the GeoPackage feature table, added by the publisher's export.

table:columns.name: Tunnus
table:columns.description: Cadastral unit ID (tunnus in the current file).

table:columns.name: Haldusyksuse_kood
table:columns.description: Settlement ID, EHAK code of the settlement unit (hkood in the current file).

table:columns.name: Maakonna_nimi
table:columns.description: County name (mk_nimi in the current file).

table:columns.name: Omavalitsuse_nimi
table:columns.description: Municipality name (ov_nimi in the current file).

table:columns.name: Asustusyksuse_nimi
table:columns.description: Settlement name (ay_nimi in the current file).

table:columns.name: Lahiaadress
table:columns.description: Address, short form without municipality (l_aadress in the current file).

table:columns.name: Registreeritud
table:columns.description: Cadastral unit registration date (registr in the current file).

table:columns.name: Muudetud
table:columns.description: Cadastral unit amendment date (muudet in the current file).

table:columns.name: Sihtotstarve_1
table:columns.description: Intended use 1 (siht1 in the current file).

table:columns.name: Sihtotstarve_2
table:columns.description: Intended use 2 (siht2 in the current file).

table:columns.name: Sihtotstarve_3
table:columns.description: Intended use 3 (siht3 in the current file).

table:columns.name: SO_protsent_1
table:columns.description: Intended use 1 percentage (so_prts1 in the current file).

table:columns.name: SO_protsent_2
table:columns.description: Intended use 2 percentage (so_prts2 in the current file).

table:columns.name: SO_protsent_3
table:columns.description: Intended use 3 percentage (so_prts3 in the current file).

table:columns.name: Pindala
table:columns.description: Area (pindala in the current file); the unit is given per row in Registreeritud_yhik.

table:columns.name: Ruumikuju_pindala
table:columns.description: Area of the geometry as stored; not in the publisher's current field table, name literally 'geometry area'.

table:columns.name: Registreeritud_yhik
table:columns.description: Unit of the registered area, e.g. m² or ha; not in the publisher's current field table, name literally 'registered unit'.

table:columns.name: Haritav_maa
table:columns.description: Cultivated area (haritav in the current file).

table:columns.name: Looduslik_rohumaa
table:columns.description: Natural grassland (rohumaa in the current file).

table:columns.name: Metsamaa
table:columns.description: Forest (mets in the current file).

table:columns.name: Ouemaa
table:columns.description: Courtyard (ouemaa in the current file).

table:columns.name: Muu_maa
table:columns.description: Other area (muumaa in the current file).

table:columns.name: Kinnistu_nr
table:columns.description: Registered immovable number (kinnistu in the current file).

table:columns.name: Moodustatud
table:columns.description: Date of formation of the cadastral unit; not in the publisher's current field table, name literally 'formed'.

table:columns.name: Moodistaja
table:columns.description: Surveyor who measured the unit; not in the publisher's current field table, name literally 'surveyor'.

table:columns.name: Moodustamisviis
table:columns.description: Method of formation of the unit; removed from the unit data in the 2024 structure change, where it moved to the boundary points.

table:columns.name: Registreerimisviis
table:columns.description: Method of registration; not in the publisher's current field table, name literally 'registration method'.

table:columns.name: Omandivorm
table:columns.description: Ownership type (omvorm in the current file).

table:columns.name: Maksustamishind
table:columns.description: Assessed value in euro (maks_hind in the current file).

table:columns.name: Maa_vaartus
table:columns.description: Land value; not in the publisher's current field table, name literally 'land value'.

table:columns.name: Marketekst
table:columns.description: Cadastral unit notations (marked in the current file).

table:columns.name: EKSPORT
table:columns.description: Extraction date of the file from the Land Cadastre.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry as a struct of xmin, ymin, xmax and ymax, added by the conversion.
